# FDR

> Spin the reel and let fate pick your next meal — a food randomizer with a
> weekly schedule and a reusable dish list, across world cuisines.

FDR is a static Next.js app: 360 dishes, 60 drinks, 60 snacks, 12 cuisines,
and meal schedules. A Rust CLI (`fdr`) and MCP server expose the same data.
